{{Quote|I only ask for now that my last days with you be ones of peace. Please, my brothers and sisters, drop your weapons and join with me in ritual.|Dariana, to the other Tarasin leaders|<ref name="Hearts of Green and Gold">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/lf20050908heartsgg|text=Hearts of Green and Gold|int=Hearts of Green and Gold}}</ref>}}
The '''Grand Conclave''' was a ritual that was held by the [[Tarasin]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. At some point during the Clone Wars, [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Dariana]]&mdash;the spiritual figurehead of the [[Hiironi irstat]] and the unofficial leader of the Tarasin people&mdash;invoked a [[Great Ritual]] to protect the interests of the Tarasin. However, in spite of the ritual, Cularin suffered as a result of the Clone Wars and over two hundred square [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] of jungle surrounding the [[City/Legends|cities]] [[Gadrin]] and [[Hedrett]] was destroyed as a result of an industrial accident, while Cularin was placed under martial law by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Tensions ran high among the Tarasin, some of whom blamed Dariana for Cularin's stryfe, which pushed the species to the brink of war. To resolve the crisis, Dariana announced that she would step down as leader of the Tarasin, and as her final act she called the Tarasin together to hold a "Grand Conclave," to celebrate peace.
